description_en: Queries the observability capacity unit (OCU) usage data of Real User Monitoring (RUM)
name: GetRumOcuStatisticData

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间的时间戳，精确到毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间的时间戳，精确到毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The type of the query. To query non-time series data, set the value to INSTANT. To query time series data, set the value to TIME_SERIES
parameters.help_zh: 查询类型，非时序数据：INSTANT，时序数据：TIME_SERIES
parameters.name: query_type

fields.help_en:
The key of the filter condition. Three types of filter conditions are provided:

Application name: pid (Note that the application name is displayed, but the application ID is actually specified)
Application type: siteType
Data type: dataType
fields.help_zh:
过滤条件Key。目前提供三种筛选条件：
应用名称：pid（注意，展示应用名称，但是实际上传入的是应用id）
应用类型：siteType
数据类型：dataType
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The type of the operator. Valid value: in
fields.help_zh: 筛选类型，目前支持in（包含）
fields.name: op_type

fields.help_en: The value of the filter condition. The value is a JSON array of strings
fields.help_zh: 过滤的值，JSON Array类型的字符串，元素为字符串
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition. Three types of filter conditions are provided:

Application name: pid (Note that the application name is displayed, but the application ID is actually specified)
Application type: siteType
Data type: dataType
parameters.help_zh:
筛选条件，
目前提供三种筛选条件：

应用名称：pid（注意，展示应用名称，但是实际上传入的是应用id）
应用类型：siteType
数据类型：dataType
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en:
The grouping fields. Valid values:

siteType: The total number of OCUs is grouped by application type.
dataType: The total number of OCUs is grouped by data type.
pid: The total number of OCUs is grouped by application ID.
appName: The total number of OCUs is grouped by application name.
startTime: The total number of OCUs is grouped by start time
parameters.help_zh:
分组字段，支持传入：
siteType，按照应用类型分组统计总OCU
dataType，按照数据类型分组统计总OCU
pid，按照应用id分组统计OCU
appName，按照应用名分组统计OCU
startTime，按照开始时间分组统计OCU
parameters.name: group

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

Code.description_en: The HTTP status code. The status code 200 indicates that the request was successful

Complete.description_en: Indicates whether the next page exists

items.description_en: The details of the queried data, in the JSON Map format
items.description_zh: 查询到的数据详情，JSON Map格式

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

Total.description_en: The total number of entries returned

Message.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed
Message.description_zh: 调用失败时返回的信息
Message.example: 内部错误，请联系客户人员。
